name: Hardware review
about: An independent role review of a frozen hardware change
title: "[Review] "
---

## Assignment

Task/PR, product stage, role, actual reviewer actor and separate implementation actor.
Role: Reality Checker / Overengineering Reviewer / Completeness Reviewer / Change Reviewer.

## Frozen inputs and coverage

Candidate commit, source/intent snapshot, tool/ruleset pins, requirements and available
schematic/PCB views, calculations and reports. State unavailable evidence.

## Findings and recommendation

Use workflow/review-report.md and finding.md. Each finding needs rule/object/evidence,
consequence, severity/gate, correction owner and observable closure condition.
Recommendation: ready_for_human_review / changes_requested / blocked / not_applicable.

## Re-review and invalidation

Record corrected inputs, independent verification, unresolved disagreements and stale
earlier reviews. This issue does not grant human approval or authority to edit CAD.
